resources.string: Off by default; enable again for this revised collection. Sends the local factory MAC when accessible, a random installation ID, fixed pages/actions, version, sessions and foreground time. The server deduplicates by a keyed MAC hash, falling back to installation ID, and does not store or display raw MACs. No app names or input text. A MAC can link reinstalls. Disabling clears pending events and resets the installation ID, but does not remove historical links. Mark physical test devices as test traffic.
Mark future reports as test traffic (emulators are automatic)
